pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0126 Timeline and Sequencer first release
pr_body:
## Summary

Rebuilds the ADR0126 Timeline/Sequencer first-release completion on the current main baseline. This first trusted stage adds the neutral Timeline core, stable Timeline identities, authoring document/compiler/service, and animation ownership hooks. Runtime, Editor/Sequencer integration, and deterministic Visual Validation are intentionally added by following exact-head stages on this same Draft branch.

Supersedes the conflicted implementation line in Draft PR #690 once this current-main completion line is fully validated.
